participation.context: Wrote the letter in the dark hour and did not seal it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote Anne, then your father and mother, then one paragraph to each child. You named what the pack may say aloud, and you left one thing for each of them unwritten. You did not seal the page.

participation.context: Left the letter open and went back to bed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the sheet waits for Thursday's cord

story.body: You sanded the close, folded the sheet, and did not seal it. You left the withheld things off the page. You pinched the candle.

relations.note: the sheet waits for Thursday's cord

title: Sanded the close and folded the letter once
